# Hypa Intelligence

> One app for African language dictionary lookups and translation. Definitions, usage, and audio in 23+ languages, alongside text, document, voice, and image translation.

The combined Hypa dictionary and translation app for African languages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://intelligence.hypaintelligence.com/)
- [Dictionary](https://intelligence.hypaintelligence.com/dictionary)
- [All languages](https://intelligence.hypaintelligence.com/dictionary/languages)
- [Translate](https://intelligence.hypaintelligence.com/translate)

## Key resources

- [Dictionary](https://intelligence.hypaintelligence.com/dictionary): Word lookups with audio.
- [Translate](https://intelligence.hypaintelligence.com/translate): Text, document, voice, and image translation.
